Segment-based rich text over nvg spans.

Build styled runs with composable constructors instead of markup: strong, em, fg, bg and link wrap a string or another segment, so @[plain("Ship "), strong(fg("faster", red))] stays typed all the way down to TextSpan. No parsing, no escaping.

Types

OgSeg = object
  text*: string
  bold*: bool
  italic*: bool
  hasFg*: bool
  fg*: Color
  hasBg*: bool
  bg*: Color
  link*: string
One styled run. link is empty for non-links; a link renders accent-colored and underlined (visual only: PNGs are static).

    forbids: [].}
Concatenate segments and build the nvg spans for them. nil faces fall back to the layout font. Links take accent unless they carry an explicit fg. 
proc trimSegs(segs: openArray[OgSeg]; maxBytes: int): seq[OgSeg] {....raises: [],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Cut concatenated segments to maxBytes (rune-boundary safe), keeping styles and dropping empties. Non-positive budgets keep just the ellipsis marker so clipped boxes never go blank.
